about_the_game:
Nitro Pulse pushes you to the edge of speed and adrenaline in a world where extreme racing has no rules. Feel the thrill of mastering vehicles, from classic cars to powerful racing cars.

Face tracks full of obstacles, impossible jumps, and unexpected hazards that will test your reflexes at every turn. Crashes and explosions aren’t just part of the scenery—they’re part of the strategy, creating constant chaos where every move counts.

Challenge your friends or race against competitors from around the world in intense multiplayer matches, or hone your skills in single-player modes packed with challenges and special events. Every race is a chance to dominate the tracks, discover hidden shortcuts, and prove who the true Nitro Pulse master is.

Get ready to feel adrenaline like never before: speed, chaos, and non-stop action await around every corner. Are you ready to ignite the engine and leave your mark in Nitro Pulse?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or better
  • Processor: Core i3 3000+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX VRAM 2GB+
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5 5000
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Nitro Pulse plunges you into explosive, adrenaline-fueled races where every turn, crash, and daring move unleashes total chaos. Master all the vehicles, tackle extreme tracks, and experience nonstop action at every moment.
